title.zh: 英伟达暴跌7.3%，纳指狂泄超千点，美股恐慌指数VIX波动率日内涨40%
title.en: 英伟达暴跌7.3%，纳指狂泄超千点，美股恐慌指数VIX波动率日内涨40%

current_state.zh: 11月5日美股广泛抛售持续并加深，标普500跌幅扩大至4%，纳指跌超5%，纳斯达克100指数跌超6%，道指跌超3%，半导体指数跌超10%。
current_state.en: The broad November 5 US equity selloff continued and deepened, with the S&P 500 down 4%, the Nasdaq down more than 5%, the Nasdaq 100 down over 6%, the Dow down more than 3%, and the semiconductor index down more than 10%.

updates.title_zh: 英伟达暴跌7.3%，纳指狂泄超千点，美股恐慌指数VIX波动率日内涨40%
updates.title_en: 英伟达暴跌7.3%，纳指狂泄超千点，美股恐慌指数VIX波动率日内涨40%
updates.what_changed_zh: 11 月 5 日美股大幅下跌，英伟达跌 7.3%，纳斯达克跌超 3.9%，VIX 盘中飙升 40%，市场出现广泛避险抛售。
updates.what_changed_en: US stocks fell sharply on November 5, with Nvidia dropping 7.3%, the Nasdaq losing over 3.9%, and the VIX surging 40% intraday amid a broad risk-off selloff.
updates.current_state_zh: 11 月 5 日美股大幅下跌，英伟达跌 7.3%，纳斯达克跌超 3.9%，VIX 盘中飙升 40%，市场出现广泛避险抛售。
updates.current_state_en: US stocks fell sharply on November 5, with Nvidia dropping 7.3%, the Nasdaq losing over 3.9%, and the VIX surging 40% intraday amid a broad risk-off selloff.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US stocks fell sharply on November 5, with Nvidia dropping 7.3%, the Nasdaq losing over 3.9%, and the VIX surging 40% intraday amid a broad risk-off selloff.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US stocks fell sharply on November 5, with Nvidia dropping 7.3%, the Nasdaq losing over 3.9%, and the VIX surging 40% intraday amid a broad risk-off selloff.

updates.title_zh: 纳指100跌幅扩大至5.1%，标普500下跌2.8%，均将创五个月来最大单日跌幅
updates.title_en: 纳指100跌幅扩大至5.1%，标普500下跌2.8%，均将创五个月来最大单日跌幅
updates.what_changed_zh: 11月5日美股抛售加深：纳指100跌幅扩大至5.1%，标普500下跌2.8%；两大指数跌至7月下旬以来最低，并势将创五个月来最大单日跌幅。
updates.what_changed_en: The November 5 US equity selloff deepened: Nasdaq 100 fell 5.1% and the S&P 500 lost 2.8%; both indices reached their lowest levels since late July and were on track for their biggest single-day losses in five months.
updates.current_state_zh: 11月5日美股广泛避险抛售加剧，纳指100跌5.1%、标普500跌2.8%，均跌至7月下旬以来最低并势将创五个月最大单日跌幅；此前英伟达跌7.3%、纳指跌超3.9%、VIX日内涨40%。
updates.current_state_en: The broad risk-off selloff intensified on November 5, with the Nasdaq 100 down 5.1% and the S&P 500 down 2.8%, both at their lowest since late July and on track for their biggest one-day losses in five months; earlier, Nvidia fell 7.3%, the Nasdaq lost over 3.9%, and the VIX rose 40% intraday.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nasdaq 100 dropped 5.1% and the S&P 500 fell 2.8% on November 5, sending both indices to their lowest levels since late July and putting them on track for their biggest single-day losses in five months.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nasdaq 100 dropped 5.1% and the S&P 500 fell 2.8% on November 5, sending both indices to their lowest levels since late July and putting them on track for their biggest single-day losses in five months.

updates.title_zh: 标普500指数跌幅扩大至3%，费城半导体指数跌超10%，英伟达跌超8%
updates.title_en: 标普500指数跌幅扩大至3%，费城半导体指数跌超10%，英伟达跌超8%
updates.what_changed_zh: 11月5日抛售进一步扩大：标普500跌幅扩大至3%，道指跌2%，纳指跌超4.8%，费城半导体指数跌超10%；英伟达跌超8%，AMD跌15.6%，闪迪跌19.4%。
updates.what_changed_en: The November 5 selloff widened further: the S&P 500 fell 3%, the Dow lost 2%, the Nasdaq dropped over 4.8%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell more than 10%; Nvidia lost over 8%, AMD fell 15.6%, and SanDisk fell 19.4%.
updates.current_state_zh: 11月5日美股广泛避险抛售持续加深，标普500跌3%、道指跌2%、纳指跌超4.8%，费城半导体指数跌超10%；英伟达跌超8%，AMD跌15.6%，闪迪跌19.4%。
updates.current_state_en: The broad risk-off US equity selloff deepened on November 5, with the S&P 500 down 3%, the Dow down 2%, the Nasdaq down over 4.8%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down more than 10%; Nvidia fell over 8%, AMD 15.6%, and SanDisk 19.4%.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US equities deepened their selloff on November 5, with the S&P 500 down 3%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down more than 10%, and major chip stocks including Nvidia, AMD, and SanDisk suffering double-digit declines.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US equities deepened their selloff on November 5, with the S&P 500 down 3%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down more than 10%, and major chip stocks including Nvidia, AMD, and SanDisk suffering double-digit declines.

updates.title_zh: 美股恐慌指数VIX飙升逾62%，突破27点关口
updates.title_en: 美股恐慌指数VIX飙升逾62%，突破27点关口
updates.what_changed_zh: 11月5日美股抛售进一步加深，VIX大涨62.73%至27.03点，盘中最高触及27.03点；纳指跌5.35%，标普500跌3.57%，道指跌2.38%。
updates.what_changed_en: The November 5 US equity selloff deepened further: the VIX surged 62.73% to 27.03, hitting an intraday high of 27.03; the Nasdaq fell 5.35%, the S&P 500 lost 3.57%, and the Dow dropped 2.38%.
updates.current_state_zh: 11月5日美股广泛避险抛售进一步加深，VIX飙升62.73%至27.03点；纳指跌5.35%，标普500跌3.57%，道指跌2.38%。
updates.current_state_en: The broad risk-off US equity selloff deepened further on November 5, with the VIX surging 62.73% to 27.03; the Nasdaq fell 5.35%, the S&P 500 lost 3.57%, and the Dow dropped 2.38%.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US equity volatility spiked violently on November 5, with the VIX surging 62.73% to 27.03 as the Nasdaq dropped 5.35%, the S&P 500 fell 3.57%, and the Dow lost 2.38%.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US equity volatility spiked violently on November 5, with the VIX surging 62.73% to 27.03 as the Nasdaq dropped 5.35%, the S&P 500 fell 3.57%, and the Dow lost 2.38%.

updates.title_zh: 费城半导体指数或将创2020年3月以来最大单日跌幅，最新下跌11.48%
updates.title_en: 费城半导体指数或将创2020年3月以来最大单日跌幅，最新下跌11.48%
updates.what_changed_zh: 费城半导体指数最新下跌11.48%，报道称或将创2020年3月以来最大单日跌幅；希捷、西部数据、美光、英特尔等半导体与存储股亦出现两位数或接近两位数下跌。
updates.what_changed_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was latest down 11.48%, with the report saying it may mark its biggest one-day drop since March 2020; Seagate, Western Digital, Micron, Intel and other chip and storage stocks also fell sharply.
updates.current_state_zh: 11月5日美股广泛避险抛售持续，VIX升至27.03点，纳指跌5.35%，标普500跌3.57%，道指跌2.38%；费城半导体指数最新跌11.48%，报道称或将创2020年3月以来最大单日跌幅。
updates.current_state_en: The broad risk-off US equity selloff continued on November 5, with the VIX at 27.03, the Nasdaq down 5.35%, the S&P 500 down 3.57%, and the Dow down 2.38%; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was latest down 11.48%, with the report saying it may be its biggest one-day fall since March 2020.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 11.48%, its steepest one-day fall since March 2020, led by double-digit losses in memory and chip stocks such as Western Digital, SanDisk, Micron and AMD, with Nvidia down 7.23%.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 11.48%, its steepest one-day fall since March 2020, led by double-digit losses in memory and chip stocks such as Western Digital, SanDisk, Micron and AMD, with Nvidia down 7.23%.

updates.title_zh: 盘点美股史上大崩盘：纳指走出互联网泡沫耗时逾十年，疫情之下半导体指数单日暴跌15.9%
updates.title_en: 盘点美股史上大崩盘：纳指走出互联网泡沫耗时逾十年，疫情之下半导体指数单日暴跌15.9%
updates.what_changed_zh: 美股广泛抛售中，开盘一小时内总市值蒸发约2.3万亿美元；标普500盘中最低约7394点、跌约3.83%，较既有报道的3.57%进一步扩大。
updates.what_changed_en: In the broad US equity selloff, about $2.3 trillion in market value was erased within the first hour; the S&P 500 hit an intraday low of about 7,394, down about 3.83%, deeper than the previously reported 3.57%.
updates.current_state_zh: 11月5日美股广泛抛售持续，开盘一小时内总市值蒸发约2.3万亿美元；标普500盘中最低约7394点、跌约3.83%，费城半导体指数跌11.48%并接近2020年3月16日15.9%的历史最大单日跌幅。
updates.current_state_en: The broad November 5 US equity selloff continued, with about $2.3 trillion in market value erased within the first hour; the S&P 500 hit an intraday low of about 7,394, down about 3.83%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 11.48%, near its March 16, 2020 record one-day drop of 15.9%.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US stocks sold off sharply, wiping about $2.3 trillion in market value within the first hour of trading, with the S&P 500 down roughly 3.83% intraday and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling 11.48%, near its March 2020 record single-day decline of 15.9%.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US stocks sold off sharply, wiping about $2.3 trillion in market value within the first hour of trading, with the S&P 500 down roughly 3.83% intraday and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling 11.48%, near its March 2020 record single-day decline of 15.9%.
